name: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
description: Standard mandatory declarations required on retail packaged commodities in India

rules.title: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer Identity & Address
rules.description: The name and complete address of the manufacturer, or where the manufacturer is not the packer, the name and address of the manufacturer and packer, or in case of imported packages, the name and address of the importer.
rules.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(a) & Rule 6(1)(ab) - Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.remediation: Print the complete name and registered address of the manufacturer or packer, including city, state, and pincode.

rules.title: Generic Name of Commodity
rules.description: The common or generic names of the commodity contained in the package and, in case of packages with more than one product, the name and number or quantity of each product.
rules.remediation: Clearly state the common or generic name of the commodity on the principal display panel.

rules.title: Net Quantity with Standard Unit
rules.description: The net quantity, in terms of standard units of weight or measure (g, kg, ml, l, m, cm) or number, contained in the package.
rules.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(c) & Rule 11 - Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.remediation: Specify the net quantity using approved SI units or symbols (e.g., 'g', 'kg', 'ml', 'l', or 'N' for numbers). Avoid non-standard notations.

rules.title: Month & Year of Manufacture / Packing
rules.description: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported, formatted clearly (e.g. MM/YYYY or Month YYYY).
rules.remediation: Provide the month and year of manufacture or packaging using standard numerical or alphabetical representations (e.g. '08/2026' or 'Aug 2026').

rules.title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
rules.description: The retail sale price of the package clearly stated as Maximum Retail Price (MRP) with currency symbol.
rules.remediation: Declare the Maximum Retail Price in Indian Rupees (e.g., 'MRP ₹ 150.00' or 'MRP Rs. 150.00').

rules.title: MRP Inclusive of All Taxes Clause
rules.description: The retail sale price declaration must explicitly state 'inclusive of all taxes' or 'incl. of all taxes'.
rules.remediation: Add the phrase 'inclusive of all taxes' or 'incl. of all taxes' directly adjacent to the MRP.

rules.title: Best Before or Use By Date
rules.description: For commodities that may become unfit for human consumption after a period of time, the 'best before' or 'use by' date, month, and year.
rules.remediation: Provide 'Best before X months from packaging' or an explicit 'Use by / Expiry' date.

rules.title: Consumer Care Redressal Mechanism
rules.description: The name, address, telephone number, and e-mail address of the person who can be or the office which can be contacted, in case of consumer complaints.
rules.remediation: Provide at least one active consumer complaint channel (toll-free telephone number, email, or postal address) for consumer queries and grievances.

rules.title: Country of Origin (Imported Commodities)
rules.description: The name of the country of origin or manufacture or assembly in case of imported commodities.
rules.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(n) - Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (as amended 2017)
rules.remediation: If the commodity is imported, explicitly declare 'Country of Origin: [Country Name]'.
